context: Skill activation is a triple pass-through chain: 53 of 59 src/skills/*.mts are byte-identical 33-37-line boilerplate (only the id string differs) whose activate() spawns node bin/omp.mjs <id> where src/index.mts has no case for 30 of those ids - Unknown subcommand, exit 1. The real skill surface is skills/<id>/SKILL.md (59 entries in plugin.json) loaded by src/utils/skill-loader.mts; the .mts modules are not the runtime surface. 26 test files (1,968 lines) mock child_process.spawn, asserting the spawn command string while never exercising the path, so the 30 dead verbs are invisible to CI. No production code imports the 53 boilerplate modules; their only consumer is the test suite.
root_causes: the .mts skill modules were generated as pass-through scaffolding and never wired to a real runtime surface
tests mock the only layer that could expose the dead verbs (child_process.spawn), so the suite conceals the bug
no end-to-end test runs the real bin/omp.mjs verb for a skill id
evidence: 53 of 59 src/skills/*.mts are byte-identical boilerplate except the id string

30 boilerplate ids (ralph, ultrawork, autopilot, team, ecomode, swarm, pipeline, wiki, trace, note, tdd, research, omp-plan, omp-setup, release, session, swe-bench, deep-interview, learner, ralplan, skillify, omp-doctor, omp-reference, notifications, configure-notifications, ai-slop-cleaner, graph-context, interactive-menu, improve-codebase-architecture, interview) spawn bin/omp.mjs <id> with no CLI case -> Unknown subcommand, exit 1
26 test files mock child_process.spawn and assert only the spawn command string
esbuild.config.mts bundles only setup.mts/mcp-setup.mts, so the .mts skills are not even shipped as bundles
solutions: delete the 53 boilerplate modules and 26 mock-only test files (~3,800 LOC)

add src/skills/spawn-skill.mts: runSkill(id, args) - resolve real bin path (fixing the cwd-relative bin/omp.mjs resolution), spawn, map to SkillOutput; the 6 real skill modules (graph-provider, graphify, graphwiki, spending, setup, mcp-setup) consume it
trim src/index.mts to verbs the CLI actually serves; guidance-only cases point at the real surface
update ARCH-002: skills are discovered via skills/<id>/SKILL.md + plugin.json, not src/skills/ modules
acceptance_criteria: the 53 boilerplate modules and 26 mock-only test files are deleted; the 6 real modules remain and consume spawn-skill.mts
src/skills/spawn-skill.mts is the one spawn seam (real bin path resolution, spawn, SkillOutput mapping)
a real-bin end-to-end test runs bin/omp.mjs <verb> for representative skill ids (no mocks) and asserts honest outcomes
src/index.mts no longer advertises 30 verbs with no case
ARCH-002 updated to the real discovery model
npm test passes; eslint/prek clean; dist/ untouched per RELEASING.md
